meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 当你要求发布新版本时，Claude 会自动更新所有配置文件的版本号、运行构建、创建 Git 标签、生成 GitHub Release 和更新变更日志，但不会发布到 npm（需要你手动操作）。
howto.when: 当你要求“发布新版本”或“打版本号”时触发。

say.text: 请帮我发布一个补丁版本，修复了登录 bug。
say.note: Claude 会分析变更类型，执行版本升级流程。

say.text: 发布一个次要版本，新增了导出功能。
say.note: Claude 会识别为 MINOR 更新，自动处理所有文件。

howto.what_en: When you ask to release a new version, Claude automatically updates version strings in all config files, runs the build, creates a Git tag, generates a GitHub release, and updates the changelog, but does NOT publish to npm (requires manual action).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "release a new version" or "bump version".

say_en.text: Please release a patch version that fixes the login bug.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the change type and execute the version bump workflow.

say_en.text: Release a minor version with the new export feature.
say_en.note: Claude will treat it as a MINOR update and handle all files automatically.
